decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ This purpose built detached single-family dwellinghouse is considered to be of an insufficient original size with regards to the Council's residential conversion guidelines for sub-division. The proposals would therefore represent an unacceptable overdevelopment of the site, which would result in inappropriate room stacking and inadequate room sizes and for the proposed self-contained flat, and insufficient private amenity space for both the main house and the proposed flat contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.5 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policies  ENV-B.1.1 and H.3.4.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposal would result in the loss of two off-street parking spaces within a CPZ, and fails to provide any off-street parking for the existing and the proposed residential unit. The proposal would therefore result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy T.1.4.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor rear extension, conversion of garage into habitable room and creation of a self contained flat.
